protocol_metadata.about: RAAC is a decentralized lending protocol for real-world assets on Ethereum, combining a Core V1 multi-collateral lending pool system with RWf(x), a stablecoin minting framework. The protocol enables tokenization of real-world assets like real estate (via RAAC NFTs) and precious metals (via fractional tokens like pmUSD for physical metals and fGOLD) into lending and borrowing markets. Core V1 features isolation pools with asset adapters, a stability pool mechanism, and treasury controls, while RWf(x) implements market-based fractional tokenization with leverage tokens.
